column1: # calcval cases for the ODF 1.4 Part 4 changes (calcval.py).  Columns (tab separated): id, formula, mode, expected, note.
# formula: AOO API syntax (English function names, ';' separators, '|' row separator in inline arrays), leading '='.
# mode: cell | cell@N (plain cell, scratch cell AA<N>; default AA1) | array[:CxR] (setArrayFormula on AA1 sized C columns x R rows; default 1x1).
# expected: '-' = record only; number (relative tolerance 1e-9; '~' prefix = 1e-6); '#N/A'; '#ERR' (any error); 's:text'; for array modes a '|' separated row-major list of those.
# RECEIVED, BESSELK, BESSELY, CONVERT are Analysis add-in functions: calcval.py rewrites them to their programmatic names.
# Expected values come from the public ODF 1.4 Part 4 text (OpenDocument-v1.4-os-part4-formula).
# Data written by calcval.py on sheet 1 (second sheet is named Other):
#   R1:T6  database: header Name,Age,Score; A,20,5; B,30,"n/a"; C,40,15; D,50,(empty); E,60,25
#   V1:V2  criteria Age,">=30"   W1:W2  criteria Age,(empty)   Y1:Y2  criteria Name,"A"
#   Scratch area AA1:AF12 is cleared after every case.
